title: Risk Score Calculator
description: Apply the risk equation from Lesson 3. Write Python code to calculate risk scores (Risk = Likelihood × Impact) for a set of assets, then identify the highest-risk asset. Complete both tasks — the flag will print when your solution is correct.
hint: Risk = Likelihood × Impact — both values on a scale of 1–5. Use a for-loop to iterate the assets list, compute each score, and print in the required format. Use Python's max() with a key= argument to find the highest-risk asset.

    {"name": "Internal Wiki",       "likelihood": 2, "impact": 2},
]
